name: What kind of paint do you use for interior painting projects?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint do you use for interior painting projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: We primarily use high-quality, professional-grade paints from reputable brands known for their durability, coverage, and low VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) content. Our standard practice involves using paints that offer excellent washability and a long-lasting finish. However, we are flexible and can accommodate specific requests if you have a preferred brand or type of paint, such as eco-friendly or allergy-sensitive options, to meet your unique needs and preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use high-quality, professional-grade, low-VOC paints from reputable brands. We can also accommodate specific brand or type requests, like eco-friendly options.
